cases.scenario: A saved chat contains valid proposals before and after an action format unavailable to this API.
cases.expected: Return valid proposals in order and a read-only unavailable notice; do not abort messages or disclose raw unsupported payload.

cases.scenario: Stored action identity or version differs from its known capability.
cases.expected: No approval projection, editor or confirmation control; keep saved record unchanged.

cases.scenario: A completed action has an unavailable receipt format.
cases.expected: Read-only notice, not whole-chat failure or fabricated receipt.

cases.scenario: A valid supported projection encounters a fresh authority or database failure.
cases.expected: Propagate legitimate failure; compatibility handling cannot bypass access or hide database errors.

acceptance: Source/guarded native read and synthetic component evidence; live HTTP recovery not yet verified.
